title: Punjab Govt Challenges Order Directing Release Of DA Arrears To Employees, Says Single Judge Lacked Jurisdiction
description: The Punjab Government represented through AG Punjab Maninderjit Singh Bedi has told the High Court that a single judge's direction for release of pending Dearness Allowance (DA) to Punjab government employees and pensioners was "corum non judice".
